items.summary:
## Problem

Support currently means asking users to run five commands (config validation, `/queue`, `/system_stats`, `/features`, Manager/Model Manager probes, audit path, auth env). The server itself cannot run without a client, so there is no single "is this setup sane?" entry point.

## Fix

Add `scripts/doctor.py` (and optionally a `--doctor` CLI flag) that checks:
